description: Per-verdict REQUIRED evidence declaration consumed by qa/evidence_audit.py. For each verdict type it lists the evidence items the release_readiness.py rollup needs, and — for each way an item can be missing — whether the gap is RECOVERABLE (re-run / more personas / more budget / supply an artifact) or a REAL failing signal (the build missed a threshold with full evidence present). evidence_audit.py is a PURE READER: it never re-runs anything, it only reads an RRI.json (or a run dir's RRI.json) and reports REQUIRED vs PRESENT, classifying each gap. The classification rule is: a failed gate that has a matching entry in RRI.json.evidence_gaps is an EVIDENCE_GAP (the gap kind is matched against the patterns below to pick the recovery action); a failed gate with NO evidence_gaps entry means the evidence was present and the measured value missed the gate threshold -> REAL_BLOCKER.

abort_is_not_a_blocker.note: When RRI.json.aborted is true (quota/session-limit 429, abort_reason=quota_session_limit), the rollup is an INFRA abort, NOT a product verdict. Every gap is reclassified as ABORTED_RECOVERABLE and the suggested action is to re-run after the quota resets (abort_detail carries the reset hint). The RRI number is not a measurement.
abort_is_not_a_blocker.action: Infra abort (account session limit / HTTP 429), not a product blocker. Re-run the sweep after the quota resets; see RRI.json.abort_detail for the reset hint.

gap_recovery_rules.action: Run the missing persona(s) at the same build SHA (more personas needed), then re-roll RRI. This is not a product failure — the gate has no evidence yet.

No success denominator for /image traffic. Re-capture the run with image network logging (network.ndjson with /image 200 rows), OR supply a same-SHA Mac --handoff-json proving health.image_probe_ok + the private art root. UNEXPECTED 404s recorded with no denominator are a harder gap: confirm whether they are designed no-art (X-Image-Outcome) before treating them as recoverable.

A required evidence input was not passed to the rollup (or its scorer was never run). Supply the artifact path / run the scorer, then re-roll RRI. The gate has no signal yet — this is not a failing measurement.
The supplied evidence path is missing on disk or malformed. Regenerate the artifact (re-run its scorer/harness) and re-roll RRI.
Release personas were measured on mixed/missing build SHAs. Re-run the canonical five at ONE build SHA (same-SHA evidence required), then re-roll RRI with --build-sha.

No native built-app proof. Re-run ui_playtest_app.sh to record part_a=PASS, OR supply a valid same-SHA Mac --handoff-json. Note: a part_a result that is present-but-not-PASS is a REAL native failure, not a gap — see native_gate_real below.

The Mac --handoff-json (or its evidence manifests/snapshots) is missing, stale-SHA, or incomplete. Re-run qa/app_handoff_gate.py at the candidate SHA and pass a complete --handoff-json. For a split VM/persona sweep also supply a same-SHA --support-preflight-json.
A split sweep that rides --handoff-json for Mac proof needs a same-SHA support-VM preflight artifact. Re-run qa/support_vm_preflight.py at the candidate SHA and pass --support-preflight-json.

A persona run produced no usable score.json (harness/backend failure, not a product verdict). Re-run that persona; inspect run.json failure_bucket/failure_detail for whether the harness or backend aborted.

rri_release.summary: Full WorldOS Release Readiness Index: 11 gates must all hold on ONE build SHA across the canonical five personas plus Mac handoff. This is the only release verdict.

real_blocker_gates._doc: When one of these gates is in RRI.json.failed_gates and has NO matching evidence_gaps entry, the evidence was present and the measured value missed the threshold -> REAL_BLOCKER. The action is to FIX THE PRODUCT, not re-run. Thresholds mirror release_readiness.py.

cross_persona_sat.threshold: avg persona_satisfaction >= 7.0/10 and every persona score_pass
cross_persona_sat.action: Product/UX blocker: cross-persona satisfaction below 7 (or a persona score_pass failed) with full evidence. Fix the experience, not the sweep.

no_give_up.action: Product blocker: a persona abandoned the game. Fix the give-up cause.

zero_critical.threshold: 0 critical bug reports and 0 console errors
zero_critical.action: Product blocker: a critical bug / console error was observed. Fix the defect.

story_craft.action: Quality blocker: story-craft lens below 4.3 with the lens present. Improve narrative quality.

mechanical.action: Quality blocker: mechanical/5e lens below 4.5 with the lens present. Fix rules adherence.

behavioral.action: Product blocker: behavioral assertions are RED with evidence present. Fix the asserted behavior.

ui_audit.action: Product blocker: UI audit FAILed with the log present. Fix the audited UI defects.

arc_completed.action: Product blocker: the arc/part_b did not complete with evidence present. Fix the blocking flow.

native_gate.action: Product blocker: a recorded part_a result is not PASS (the built app failed a native transition with evidence). Fix the native shell.

palette_live.action: Product blocker: the live palette/session-surface read was false with the source present. Fix the live surface.

image_render.threshold: render rate >= 95% over a real denominator
image_render.action: Product blocker: image render rate below 95% over a real denominator (recorded unexpected 404s). Fix image resolution — this is NOT recoverable by more runs.

duo_quality.summary: Story + mechanical quality lenses from a duo (player+DM) run. Used to answer whether a quality dip is a real craft regression or just an un-scored / un-supplied lens.

story_craft.action: Real craft regression: story lens below 4.3 with the lens present. Improve narrative quality (story is the north star).

mechanical.action: Real rules regression: mechanical lens below 4.5 with the lens present. Fix 5e adherence.

combat_sprint_median.summary: Fast combat-fidelity bug-finder. The mechanical signal is the median of N sprint runs; a single low run is an evidence gap (need more runs), a low median with N>=3 runs present is a real adherence blocker.

mechanical.action: Real combat-adherence blocker: median mechanical over >=3 runs below 4.5. Fix the action-economy / rules defect. (A low single run with <3 runs is an EVIDENCE_GAP — run more sprints.)
